alt: The night market quarter at 20:30, mid-set: Rico walks the warm festival paving between ten stalls with striped awnings — tacos, ramen, dumplings, sweets, juice, barbecue, noodles, coffee, flowers and books — paper lanterns swaying from the string lights over a crowd of browsers gathered at the stage for the band's set, twenty-six strong and bobbing to the beat, and the festival stage at the north end with its red curtain and a three-piece band playing under a MERCADO sign
name: 1-market.jpg

alt: A five-star night chase in downtown Solmar: the police helicopter hangs over Rico's car with its searchlight beam on him — the bright pool of light lagging on the street where he swerves, the cone falling from the dark PD bird with its blinking nav lights and spinning rotor — while a roadblock of two cruisers waits sideways across the road ahead, light bars flashing, and patrol cars chase through the neon-lit streets below the night market quarter
name: 2-heli.jpg

alt: A three-star police chase through downtown Solmar at night in a thunderstorm: a forked lightning bolt splits the sky over the towers with a second branch reaching the ground, the whole street washes white with the flash, and behind the fleeing car three patrol cars with flashing light bars chase through rain-slicked streets where the neon burns twice as bright, their headlight cones stretched long on the wet asphalt
name: 3-storm.jpg

alt: Golden hour over the new airfield on the north edge: the prop plane lifts off the runway, its shadow still on the asphalt below, with the hangar and its AIRFIELD sign behind it, the painted runway markings and amber edge lights, white approach strobes, a windsock leaning in the breeze and fuel drums by the hangar, and Rico waiting in a car on the north road below
name: 4-airport.jpg
